checks.name: order
rebinding
checks.source:
class Box: pass
first=Box(); first.value=1
second=Box(); second.value=10
current=first
def rhs():
 global current
 current=second
 return 2
current.value+=rhs()
print(first.value,second.value,current is second)

box.value+=[2]
print(alias,alias is box.value)

checks.name: readonly-inplace

checks.source:
events=[]
class Value:
 def __iadd__(self,other): events.append('iadd'); return NotImplemented
 def __add__(self,other): events.append('add'); return 7
class Box: pass
box=Box();box.value=Value()
box.value+=2
print(events,box.value)

checks.name: missing-before-rhs
locals
checks.source:
class Box: pass
box=Box();box.value=1
def run(box):
 delta=2
 box.value+=locals()['delta']
 return locals()['box'] is box
print(run(box),box.value)

checks.name: yield-rhs
checks.source:
class Box: pass
box=Box();box.value=1
def update(box):
 box.value+=(yield 'rhs')
 yield box.value
g=update(box); print(next(g),g.send(2),box.value)

checks.name: yield-receiver
checks.source:
class Box: pass
box=Box();box.value=1
def update():
 (yield 'receiver').value+=2
 yield 'updated'
g=update(); print(next(g),g.send(box),box.value)

checks.name: nonlocal
checks.source:
def outer():
 class Box: pass
 box=Box();box.value=1
 def run():
  nonlocal box
  box.value+=2
 run()
 return box.value
print(outer())
